k_value.docs:
**int**: The K value comes from the list below. It will default to 4096 if not specified.

*See also: [CFSensor XGZP68xx Non-C Series Differential Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xgzp68xx#configuration-variables)*

oversampling.docs:
One of `256x`, `512x`, `1024x`, `2048x`, `4096x`, `8192x`, `16384x`, `32768x`. It is not possible to disable oversampling. If not specified, this defaults to `4096x`.

*See also: [CFSensor XGZP68xx Non-C Series Differential Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/xgzp68xx#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
